candidates.name: East-West Pipeline / Petroline Capacity Expansion (proposed 2026)
candidates.from: Abqaiq (or East-West Corridor / Persian Gulf oil fields)

evidence.note: Reports Saudi Arabia is weighing a 1-2 MMbpd expansion of the East-West pipeline (current throughput 7 MMbpd, ~5 MMbpd exportable). Unclear if expansion means upgrading existing line or new infrastructure; one source says proposal could include a second, smaller parallel pipeline for refined products. Kuwait Petroleum CEO confirmed regional discussions ('in discussions with our brothers in Saudi Arabia and in the emirates to look at how to expand the pipeline system'). Aramco declined to comment; Saudi government, Bahrain, Iraq, QatarEnergy did not respond. No official confirmation as of article date.

Describes 'preliminary discussions' about increasing East-West Pipeline capacity by 1-2 Mbd, with industry sources indicating focus on a parallel products pipeline rather than expanding the existing crude line. Notes the real constraint is Yanbu terminal loading capacity (4.5-5 Mbd max), and that a start-up date is 'feasible from 2028 onwards' if pursued. Explicitly preliminary/unconfirmed - no official announcement or engineering studies cited.

Trade-press writeup of the same reported expansion: up to 2 MMbpd increase (7->~9 MMbpd), uncertain whether via upgrade or new pipe, one source citing a second smaller products pipeline. Confirms reporting relies on five anonymous sources; Aramco and Saudi government did not comment. Frames the driver as regional Strait of Hormuz bypass capacity following the Feb 2026 Iran war/blockade.

Background context: East-West pipeline (Petroline, Abqaiq->Yanbu) and UAE's Habshan-Fujairah/ADCOP pipeline together have an estimated 3.5-5.5 MMbpd of available bypass capacity for the Strait of Hormuz; establishes the existing-system baseline against which any expansion would be additive.

candidates.why_maybe_new: This is the specific lead flagged in the task brief. No new PID match: existing rows P0551 (East-West Crude Oil Pipeline, cap 5,000,000 bpd) and P2017 (East-West Crude Oil Pipeline / Expansion, cap 2,000,000 bpd) are the CURRENT East-West system and must not be duplicated - this candidate is a further, NOT-YET-BUILT capacity add layered on top of those, and if it proceeds as a distinct parallel products pipeline (rather than a loop/debottleneck of P0551/P2017) it would eventually be its own row. As instructed, treat this strictly: as of 2026-07-17 there is no official Aramco/Saudi government confirmation (Aramco 'declined to comment' across all three trade-press sources), the engineering approach (loop vs. new parallel line vs. products-only line) is undetermined, and no FID/route/timeline has been announced - the add-threshold is not met and this likely belongs in the consolidator as class=monitor rather than a new tracker row. Flagging here per the task brief so it is tracked for the next review pass rather than dropped.
